_comment: VFW Post 7294 specials + events. Maintained weekly via a scheduled Claude Cowork task that reads the VFW Post 7294 Facebook page and transcribes specials/events into this file. (Previously sourced from vfwpost7294.org.)
_format: weeklySpecials: { dateRange (human-readable), validThrough (ISO date — last day specials are valid, exclusive), items (array of strings, optional ' (Fri only)' or ' (Friday only)' suffix). events: array of { title, date (ISO with TZ), endTime (optional ISO with TZ), description (optional), price (optional) }. recurring: stable day→name map of nightly themes (rarely changes — Cowork need not touch). note: stable members/guests note. Date/time uses America/New_York offset. NOTE: this file is the SINGLE SOURCE for VFW specials — the app reads weekly specials + recurring from here, not from specials.json.
note: Members & Guests · Weekly specials change each week

events.title: Bri's Backyard BBQ
events.description: Bri's Backyard BBQ outside at the Trooper John Pavilion. Members and guests all invited — feel free to bring a dish to share! (No canteen.)

events.title: 9/11 Golf Outing 2026
events.description: Millersville-Manor VFW Post 7294 annual golf outing fundraiser at Crossgates GC. Shotgun start at 1 PM, BBQ dinner and awards at 5 PM. Limited to the first 18 teams; registration payments due by August 9, 2026.

events.title: Make Cruisin' Fun Again
events.description: Car show presented by The Vagabonds Rod & Custom Club and the Millersville VFW Post 7294. Free to attend — all makes & models welcome. Donations support both organizations. Beverages & limited menu available.
